levelrail-mcp: an MCP server exposing the control plane's REST API as tools over stdio or streamable HTTP.

Flags:
  -all
    	list every tool at once instead of the small core plus enable_toolset, for clients without tools/list_changed support (or set APP_MCP_ALL=1)
  -allow-write
    	expose confirm-gated write tools such as extend_preview and run_restore_drill (or set APP_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE=1); never exposed in read-only mode
  -api-url string
    	control plane API base URL (overrides APP_API_URL and the credentials file, default http://localhost:8080)
  -listen string
    	address to bind in --transport=http mode (default 127.0.0.1:8090, loopback only)
  -mode string
    	tool exposure: "read-only", "standard" (default, no destructive tools) or "full" (overrides APP_MCP_MODE)
  -output-schemas
    	advertise every tool's outputSchema in tools/list, about 2.4x the listing size (or set APP_MCP_OUTPUT_SCHEMAS=1)
  -print-config string
    	print a ready MCP client config block for one of: claude, cursor, vscode, zed, then exit (read-only unless --allow-write or --mode is set)
  -profile string
    	named credentials profile to read (overrides APP_PROFILE, default "default")
  -project string
    	narrow every request to one project (overrides APP_PROJECT)
  -readonly
    	refuse to start unless the API token holds no write, write:sensitive, deploy or root ability, and expose read tools only (or set APP_MCP_READONLY=1)
  -team string
    	narrow every request to one team (overrides APP_TEAM)
  -token string
    	API token (overrides APP_API_TOKEN and the credentials file)
  -tool-profile string
    	tool profile: "agent-core" exposes a small allowlist of core agent tools (overrides APP_MCP_TOOL_PROFILE)
  -toolsets string
    	comma separated tool groups to expose, default all (overrides APP_MCP_TOOLSETS)
  -transport string
    	MCP transport: "stdio" (default, spawn as a local subprocess) or "http" (network-reachable, requires an API token)
